CHONPS formula assignment

Source: vignettes/formula-assignment.Rmd
formula-assignment.Rmd

DOMformulaR independently enumerates neutral C, H, O, N, P, and S formulae, converts theoretical neutral mass to [M-H]-, applies ppm, ratio, DBE, nominal-valence, parity, and heteroatom rules, and retains every candidate before deterministic ranking.

The default parameter set is derived from the audited project workflow for comparability. It is not a universal default. Candidate ranking is not a posterior probability and does not convert exact-mass matching into compound identification.

library(DOMformulaR)
cfg <- dom_config(elements = list(
  C = c(4, 12), H = c(0, 30), O = c(1, 12),
  N = c(0, 2), P = c(0, 1), S = c(0, 1)
))
head(generate_chonps_formulas(cfg, c(150, 300)))
##     C  H O N P S neutral_mass_theoretical molecular_formula       H_C       O_C

Key methodological references are Kujawinski and Behn (2006), DOI 10.1021/ac0600306, and Koch et al. (2007), DOI 10.1021/ac061949s.
